## My request:
시각 의미 데이터와 후보 데이터에 반영해줘. 그 다음 스킬의 최신 버전을 사용하여 독립된 서브에이전트 3개에서 각각 서로 다른 컨셉으로 이번에 반영한 주제가 이미지에 실제로 반영되는지까지 테스트할 수 있는 주제에 어울리는 랜덤한 컨셉을 정하여 테스트케이스를 마련하고 첨부한 이미지를 활용하여 프롬프트 작성하고 이미지 생성하도록 하여 잘 반영되었는지 테스트해줘.
interpreted_intent: Requester meaning: independently choose a distinct concept suited to the current topic, use the supplied image, and later generate and test it. The supplied prior-user topic context resolves the topic to school life; it adds no new active request or permissions. Reference scope is the visible face and bob haircut, with identity and original-image age unasserted. Authorial allocation is school art, clubs and festival activity. I compared a student arranging a club exhibition against a joint screen-print reveal: the latter makes a concrete shared goal, hand-to-tool mechanism and visible outcome readable in one photograph. The selected fiction depicts two 19-year-old final-year students seeing a clean festival print emerge; age, cast count, printing technique, wardrobe, colors, classroom staging and camera are agent choices. The viewer should recognize invested classroom collaboration and share their small moment of relief. Sensual=1 is confined to subtle everyday human appeal in expressive presence; fetish=0 and surreal=0 add no treatment, and creativity=1 keeps the invention close to school life. The main student, both grips, hinges and printed result must fit one oblique table view at a useful scale; the screen is raised enough for the paper to remain visible. These staging priorities do not become requester locks.
subject: Primary fictional 19-year-old school student with reference-grounded facial appearance and bob haircut; a second fictional 19-year-old student participates as authorial staging.
setting: A secondary-school classroom used as an art-club print room before the school festival.
event: Students participate in a school activity; the authored moment is a hinged silkscreen lift revealing the last festival print while a classmate points out its clean edge.
visual_priorities: The main reference-guided face and two hands belong visibly to the student lifting the near rail of the far-hinged screen.
The lifted mesh, its hinges, the gap above the taped sheet and the fresh wave print are readable together as a print reveal.
The second student points above the fresh print and the main student follows that same target with a beginning relieved smile.
Classroom furniture, a club-duty chalk grid and clipped earlier prints locate the collaboration within school festival preparation.
baseline_prompt_en: A distinct school-life photograph of students participating in a school activity, caught at the reveal of a handmade festival poster. The primary figure is a student using the supplied reference for facial appearance and hair. Preserve the reference's soft oval facial structure, dark brown eyes, straight dark brows, small nose and naturally full pink lips, together with the dark chin-length bob and wispy fringe. Stage her as a fictional 19-year-old final-year secondary-school student in a white school shirt, loosened green neck ribbon and charcoal cardigan, her sleeves turned back for practical work. In a classroom temporarily used by the school art club, two joined school desks support a wooden silkscreen printing frame. She has just pulled the final print for tomorrow's school festival. Her left hand grips the near-left wooden rail and her right hand grips the near-right rail, lifting the screen toward its far-edge hinge clamps. The tilted mesh rises above a flat sheet of paper taped to the table, revealing a freshly printed cobalt wave and coral sun with crisp edges. Show the two hand-to-rail contacts, the hinges, the screen-to-paper gap and the wet print together. Her shoulders incline slightly over the desk while both feet support her on the classroom floor. A second fictional 19-year-old student stands beside the table, one palm resting on the desk, her other index finger pointing above a clean edge of the revealed print. The main student's concentrated gaze follows that fingertip to the paper; a small relieved smile is beginning as they recognize that the print worked. Their attention converges on the same revealed result. On the blackboard behind them are a chalked club-duty grid and a simple festival date, while earlier prints hang from clips beneath the classroom windows. Regular school chairs and school bags remain visibly pushed under neighboring desks. Use a horizontal three-quarter medium-wide view from the open end of the table, with the main face, both hands, tilted screen and entire printed sheet large enough to read together. Soft late-afternoon window light crosses her face and illuminates the paper; retain ordinary skin texture, worn desk edges and slight ink stains on the frame. Natural photographic perspective, restrained color and moderate depth of field keep the printing partnership clear while the recognizable classroom stays legible.
